data.title: Polish résumé & Crème brûlée views
data.body:
## Experience goals

- Keep **epics**, tasks, and dependencies visible.
- Preserve selection while external events arrive.
- Fit cleanly from `72` to `160` columns.

```go
program := tea.NewProgram(model)
```

The detail pane renders long Markdown without leaking terminal layout concerns into the task adapter. This final paragraph intentionally wraps across several lines so the visual fixture exercises realistic prose rather than a tiny placeholder.
